name: Signed Recruitment Letter
summary: Kargal Battlescar sends the Signed Recruitment Letter west from the Far Watch Post. His mark directs new recruits to report for duty at the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Conscript's Transfer
sections.body: At the Far Watch Post, Kargal Battlescar prepares recruits for service in the Barrens. The post stands east of the Southfury River, where newcomers cross from Durotar. When a conscript proves ready to Kargal, he stamps and signs a letter of introduction. The orders send recruits west along the road to the Crossroads. There, Sergra Darkthorn coordinates supplies and the defense of the dry plains.

sections.title: Tension at the Outposts
sections.body: Kargal's orders carry his personal contempt for the officer who awaits the recruit. He calls Sergra Darkthorn an abrasive shaman who talks in circles around soldiers. Kargal openly questions Warchief Thrall's high opinion of her. Even so, the dispatch must reach Sergra's hands before any further assignments at the Crossroads are granted.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Signed Recruitment Letter?
faq.answer: The Signed Recruitment Letter transfers you from Kargal Battlescar at the Far Watch Post to duty in the Barrens. It shows Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads that Kargal has judged you ready.
Kargal Battlescar signs the letter. The orc veteran oversees the Far Watch Post on the border between Durotar and the Barrens, and signs after a recruit completes initial duties there.

faq.q: Who do I deliver the letter to?
aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: You deliver the letter to Sergra Darkthorn, an influential orc shaman stationed at the Crossroads' central intersection.

faq.q: Why does Kargal speak poorly of Sergra Darkthorn?
faq.answer: Kargal calls Sergra sharp-tongued and difficult, and thinks she wastes time talking when work needs doing. Warchief Thrall holds her in high regard, but Kargal doubts her leadership.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry this letter from basic service in Durotar into the Horde's wider frontier forces.
As a shaman, you report to Sergra Darkthorn, an orc shaman whom Thrall has entrusted with helping secure the Barrens.
